# Private source candidate

This is a private source patch of the published parse-git-config3.0.0 implementation, not an official upstream release. The publisher points to upstream Git commit60d1e75fe796ba4149bfceeb63b983503b21003c, whose manifest still says2.0.3; the overlapping implementation matches the publisher archive. The exact original17-file source and all original cases are retained in Git history before this patch.

Section and subsection names are expanded using own data properties so inherited objects and prototype setters are not followed. Normal section names and subsection values remain data. All original tests, helpers, fixtures, README and npm test script remain unchanged. Current stable direct declarations are selected from public registry metadata.

The package keeps its upstream name/version and is marked private with explicit source-port metadata. Version-based advisories remain visible; no release/advisory clearance is claimed. This candidate is not consumed by Sneup or its Airtap dependency. Original complete hosted commands, normal resolution, audit, stable-graph, source and native acceptance remain required. No publication or deployment is authorized by this candidate.

The private port targets Node26.12.1+ within26.x. Current INI records are recursively reified through Object.fromEntries to preserve the original plain-record API while defining own data properties without prototype setters. All original INI keys/values, arrays and ordinary section expansion remain data. The hosted worker sets real core.autocrlf=false; this maintains exact checkout bytes and provides an actual global Git configuration for the original location-discovery case. No original case/helper/fixture or assertion is edited.
